name: Bungo Stray Dogs · NIGHT
notes: Editorial power proposals, not official power levels. Character roster is not an image inventory or a rendered card collection.

roster.name: Atsushi Nakajima
roster.basis: Tiger transformation gives exceptional mobility, strength, and recovery.
roster.limits: The source portrait must show the depicted state; full tiger requires different art.

roster.name: Osamu Dazai
roster.basis: Contact nullification is a decisive counter to gifted opponents.
roster.limits: Still has a normal human body and must physically make contact.

roster.name: Doppo Kunikida
roster.basis: Can materialise tools and weapons through his notebook.
roster.limits: Notebook constraints and preparation limit its versatility.

roster.name: Ranpo Edogawa
roster.basis: Extraordinary deduction and planning produce major strategic advantages.
roster.limits: His deduction is not a supernatural attack or defence.

roster.name: Junichiro Tanizaki
roster.basis: Wide-area illusion and concealment support stealthy takedowns.
roster.limits: Illusions do not grant enhanced physical durability.

roster.name: Kenji Miyazawa
roster.basis: Extremely high physical strength and resilience under the right condition.
roster.limits: Power depends on hunger; everyday meals change his availability.

roster.name: Akiko Yosano
roster.basis: Powerful recovery ability with significant team survival value.
roster.limits: Healing conditions and offensive limitations matter.

roster.name: Kyoka Izumi
roster.basis: Summons an exceptionally dangerous armed spectral combatant.
roster.limits: Ability control and positioning vary by arc and form.

roster.name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
roster.basis: Expert swordsmanship and unusually strong group ability control.
roster.limits: Support ability is not itself a large destructive attack.

roster.name: Ryunosuke Akutagawa
roster.basis: Rashomon is an elite ranged cutting and defensive ability.
roster.limits: Close physical condition and matchup counters are significant.

roster.name: Chuya Nakahara
roster.basis: High-level gravity control allows major offence and mobility.
roster.limits: Corruption is a separate dangerous state and not included here.

roster.name: Motojiro Kajii
roster.basis: Explosive lemon-shaped devices and blast immunity enable ambushes.
roster.limits: Preparation and limited combat applications constrain the grade.

roster.name: Koyo Ozaki
roster.basis: Highly lethal guardian-spirit sword combat.
roster.limits: Does not inherit unrelated or hypothetical transformations.

roster.name: Ichiyo Higuchi
roster.basis: Trained armed human operative with organisational resources.
roster.limits: No confirmed innate supernatural attack.

roster.name: Elise
roster.basis: A dangerous manifestation controlled by Mori.
roster.limits: Rank applies to depicted manifestation, not an independent extra power.

roster.name: Ogai Mori
roster.basis: Controls Elise and uses strategy to shape engagements.
roster.limits: Strategic influence alone does not imply overwhelming offence.

roster.name: Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald
roster.basis: Money-fuelled amplification can grant extraordinary strength.
roster.limits: Strength depends on actual expenditure and cannot be assumed permanently.

roster.name: Lucy Maud Montgomery
roster.basis: Pocket-domain confinement allows potent capture and control.
roster.limits: Domain mechanics and escape conditions constrain encounters.

roster.name: Edgar Allan Poe
roster.ability: Black Cat in the Rue Morgue
roster.basis: Can draw opponents into a narrative environment.
roster.limits: Power requires authored fiction and is not raw combat strength.

roster.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
roster.basis: Exceptionally dangerous and difficult-to-counter gifted antagonist.
roster.limits: Specific later-manga revelations require a separate continuity review.

roster.name: Nikolai Gogol
roster.basis: Portal manipulation provides lethal spatial mobility and surprise.
roster.limits: Range and positioning are not unlimited.

roster.name: Sigma
roster.faction: Sky Casino / Decay of the Angel
roster.basis: Information transfer is a powerful tactical advantage.
roster.limits: Noncombat utility is not equivalent to apex direct attack.

roster.name: Bram Stoker
roster.basis: Vampire conversion and control can produce very large-scale threat.
roster.limits: Dependence, access and external command conditions matter.

roster.name: Mushitaro Oguri
roster.basis: Can obscure evidence of crimes and profoundly distort investigations.
roster.limits: Does not independently provide elite battle output.

roster.name: Saigiku Jono
roster.basis: Extraordinary sensory skill and difficult-to-hit particle form.
roster.limits: Matchup counters and actual anime feats bound the ranking.

roster.name: Tetcho Suehiro
roster.basis: Elite swordsman with unusually flexible blade attacks.
roster.limits: Does not gain Fukuchi's external sword power.

roster.name: Michizo Tachihara
roster.basis: Metal manipulation enables ranged, tactical attacks.
roster.limits: The metal available nearby constrains combat.

roster.name: Teruko Okura
roster.basis: Can alter apparent biological age through touch.
roster.limits: Requires contact; body modifications do not justify unlimited force.

roster.name: Ochi Fukuchi
roster.basis: Veteran strength plus amplified weapon capability is exceptionally dangerous.
roster.limits: The time-cutting sword is equipment-specific, not his innate gift.

roster.name: Sakunosuke Oda
roster.basis: Brief danger precognition gives a substantial combat edge.
roster.limits: Prediction does not directly create new offensive power.

roster.name: Ranpo Edogawa (young)
roster.basis: Prodigious deductive skill at the time of the agency's founding.
roster.limits: This is a distinct age/costume and needs dedicated young art.

roster.name: Yukichi Fukuzawa (young)
roster.basis: Highly dangerous conventional swordsman during the founding era.
roster.limits: Do not give young Fukuzawa a later unrelated costume.

roster.name: Ango Sakaguchi
roster.basis: Object-memory reading creates valuable intelligence.
roster.limits: Information retrieval is not enhanced direct damage.

roster.name: Tatsuhiko Shibusawa
roster.basis: Ability-separation fog can disrupt and threaten gifted enemies.
roster.limits: Movie-continuity mechanics must not be merged into other forms.
